note: Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 3 points; no flow deck. A 'Proceed to Revival' button exists and validates the form, but the result is only a generic confirmation modal 'Are you sure you want to Revive the selected notices?' with no notice list. The notice summary exists as a 'Summary' tab on the same page that can be opened at any time; Proceed does not move the officer to that summary, so 'Proceed -> OCMS shows a summary for confirmation' is only partial. No data changes before the officer presses OK. No maintenance ticket changes this step.
recommendation: Claim partially: the Proceed button, validation and confirmation exist; the summary does not appear automatically after Proceed (only a separate Summary tab).

steps.step: A Proceed to Revival button is available while notices remain in the list
steps.detail: The 'Proceed to Revival' button is built at RevivalForm.tsx:304-310 and rendered only when haveNotices is true (RevivalForm.tsx:337-355). It sits in the top-right menu, so it is visible on both the Revival Details and Summary tabs.

steps.step: On Proceed the form is validated and stops if the reason is missing
steps.detail: onConfirmation runs validate() (RevivalForm.tsx:71). On failure the alert 'Failed to proceed REVIVAL. Please check your form.' shows and focus moves to the faulty field (RevivalForm.tsx:72-84); the only rule checked is the required reason (Revival.ts:23-33).

steps.step: After Proceed, OCMS shows a summary of the notices to be revived for confirmation
steps.detail: After validation passes, onConfirmation only opens a ModalConfirm titled 'Revival Confirmation' with the text 'Are you sure you want to Revive the selected notices?' (RevivalForm.tsx:85-92,284-292). The modal carries no notice list or details. The summary (RevivalList in SUMMARY mode + RevivalSummary) exists as a 'Summary' tab (RevivalForm.tsx:390-417) that the officer can open at any time; it is not a result of pressing Proceed, and no code switches to the Summary tab after Proceed. So the officer confirms through a generic modal; the summary is only seen if the officer opens it.

steps.step: No data changes until the officer approves the confirmation
steps.detail: The staff-revive-suspension request is only called from onAPI, which onSubmit runs after handleComModalOk (RevivalForm.tsx:206-210,269-272); Proceed itself only validates and opens the modal. The server does have a checking=true dry-run mode (SuspensionProcessingController.java:636-657) but the UI does not use it (no 'checking' in RevivalForm.tsx/Revival.ts), so there is no extra server check between Proceed and confirmation; eligibility was already checked at selection (OCMS19.6).
